mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a quarter indicates a strengthening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate dropped by more than 0.5% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals robust consumer demand, which is expected to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenues and earnings grow.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month indicates a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to potential disruptions in the production chain and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, which is expected to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month indicates a surge in demand for new homes, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the housing market's strength reflects broader economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 10% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where the level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average provides a continuous signal: when INDPRO is above its 12-month average, it suggests robust supply-side activity, which is expected to correlate with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.
